# deed_project_member (Resource)

A user's explicit role in a Deed project (`viewer`, `editor` or `admin`). Requires the project `admin` role (or an installation admin token). Destroying the resource removes the role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "deed_project_member" "alice" {
  project = deed_project.homelab.name
  user_id = "usr_01m5qxa3jpemn9k3x8n16ftjc3"
  role    = "editor" # viewer, editor or admin
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) Project name or ID. Changing it forces a new resource (the same project by name or ID does not).
- `role` (String) Project role: `viewer`, `editor` or `admin`.
- `user_id` (String) User ID (`usr_…`). Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) The user's display name.
- `email` (String) The user's email address.
- `id` (String) `<project_id>/<user_id>`.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`prj_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import deed_project_member.alice homelab/usr_01m5qxa3jpemn9k3x8n16ftjc3 # <project>/<user_id>
```
